sentences.en: MethodsThe some hematological and biochemical indexes were determined by semi-automatic biochemical analyzer and hemacytometer in 10 kinds of usual SPF grade rats and mice of different ages and sexes.

sentences.en: Methods Retrospectively analyze the hematological clinical manifestation in 182 cases of infectious mononucleosis.

sentences.en: The patients' general conditions improved obviously, neither hematological nor immunological examination changed obviously, nor complications such as esophageal perforation or hematorrhea.
